|rulings=* (Lost function) If Dark's draws and Light's draws add up to the same total, neither player has a lower total, and so neither player will be at risk of losing 6 Force to [[Sith Fury]].<ref name="scomp">Players Committee card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026181124id_/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* (Lost function) If Dark only has 1 card in Reserve Deck (or Light only has 2 cards in Reserve Deck), they still draw destiny and may still have the higher total. But if a player has 0 cards in Reserve Deck, they have no [[Sith Fury]] total and lose automatically (unless both players have 0 cards in Reserve Deck, in which case it is a tie and neither player will be at risk of losing 6 Force to [[Sith Fury]]).
